details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: memory corruption in HTTP/2 flow control
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-123007.patch: account for frames queued but
       not yet sent when validating a client WINDOW_UPDATE, so refunding
       them on stream termination can no longer push the connection send
       window above NGX_HTTP_V2_MAX_WINDOW
     - CVE-2026-123007
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free during response processing in resolver
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-123634.patch: release a non-current resolve
       finalized from another resolve handler through a finalizer instead of
       reporting it, and report an error to waiting requests when restarting
       a resolve with a CNAME fails
     - CVE-2026-123634
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free in mail proxy module
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-113425.patch: block client writes while
       waiting for the auth_http response, while connecting to the upstream
       and while resolving the SMTP client, discard the queued reply when an
       auth_http request starts, and switch the client handlers when a
       session is quitting
       (includes the nginx 1.17.3 SMTP read-blocking change it builds on)
     - CVE-2026-113425
   * SECURITY UPDATE: buffer overflow with try_files and alias
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-125283.patch: recalculate the length after
       running the script
     - CVE-2026-125283
   * SECURITY UPDATE: endless loop while reading the request body over
     SSL
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-118899.patch: explicit handling of
       NGX_AGAIN
     - CVE-2026-118899
